paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Shmuel.
He is mentioned in Zevachim 6b, where he posed a difficulty to Rav Papa. But the reading in the Shitah Mekubetzet is “son of Rav Shemaya,” which Hyman considers correct.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: ו: gives Zevachim 6b by convention, without a new named-edition check.

Shitah Mekubetzet remains the supplied work title without author/edition identification. Son of Rav Shemaya differs from son of Rav Shmuel; והוא הנכון is Hyman’s firm judgment, not fresh verification.

The headed Yosef is naturally the implicit person posing a difficulty to Papa. All four full רב titles are retained; the absence of an explicit repeated subject does not reverse questioner and addressee.
